name: FedEx Ground Hub - Goodyear AZ (Phoenix)
type: Ground regional distribution hub (~425K sq ft regional sortation, with package center)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck entrance is on the NE corner off 143rd Ave - a very wide open paved apron/driveway with NO barrier arm or sliding gate across the truck lane (2024/2025 Street View sv13/sv15). The yard interior carries an ornamental steel security fence (visible W side, sv7-sv10) but the truck driveway opening is left open and uncontrolled - truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the NE entrance - only a small free-standing sign post. No checkpoint structure observed. guardShack false; remoteGs false because there is no controlled gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The NE entrance is an exceptionally wide paved apron with abundant unused width - ample room to add lanes / express bypass.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron inside the entrance and between the building and yards gives deep internal truck holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved entry apron and internal drives - room to queue 3+ trucks before docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large cross-dock building with continuous dock doors on BOTH the N and S long faces, trailers backed in on each; ~130 doors estimated - count approximate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large trailer drop yards (N of building and S of building) holding well over 50 parked trailers without tractors - dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two opposite faces (N and S) of the building act as physically separate dock clusters - likely separate ship/receive flows; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the site - it is an industrial park parcel, not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Building 2 of Prologis Commerce Park at Goodyear, a 1.7M sq ft 4-building industrial park ~20 mi W of downtown Phoenix - dense industrial fabric, Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: FedEx occupies a single building (Building 2); the other Prologis park buildings are separate tenants - not a FedEx campus.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One FedEx cross-dock building (~425K sq ft) confirmed by FedEx logo on the office front in 2024 Street View.
